system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-grade Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for SaaS multi-tenant application
Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC ID for the Aurora cluster
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: Private subnet IDs across multiple AZs
  AppSecurityGroupId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup::Id
    Description: Security group ID of the application layer
  DBName:
    Type: String
    Default: saas_tenant_db
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*'
  MasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: saasadmin
    NoEcho: true
  MasterUserPassword:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    MinLength: 16
  MinACU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 0.5
    MaxValue: 128
  MaxACU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 128
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of KMS key for encryption (leave blank for AWS managed)
    Default: ''
Conditions:
  HasKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]
Resources:
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for Aurora Serverless v2
      SubnetIds: !Ref PrivateSubnetIds
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-group
  AuroraSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow PostgreSQL access from application layer
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 5432
          ToPort: 5432
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AppSecurityGroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-aurora-sg
  DBClusterParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBClusterParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Family: aurora-postgresql15
      Description: Custom parameter group for SaaS multi-tenant workload
      Parameters:
        shared_preload_libraries: pg_stat_statements,pg_hint_plan
        max_connections: '5000'
        log_min_duration_statement: '1000'
        log_statement: 'ddl'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-cluster-params
  AuroraCluster:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBCluster
    Properties:
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: '15.4'
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-cluster
      DatabaseName: !Ref DBName
      MasterUsername: !Ref MasterUsername
      MasterUserPassword: !Ref MasterUserPassword
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref AuroraSecurityGroup
      StorageEncrypted: true
      KmsKeyId: !If [HasKmsKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      EnableIAMDatabaseAuthentication: true
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 14
      PreferredBackupWindow: '03:00-04:00'
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: 'sun:04:00-sun:05:00'
      DeletionProtection: true
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - postgresql
      DBClusterParameterGroupName: !Ref DBClusterParameterGroup
      ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration:
        MinCapacity: !Ref MinACU
        MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxACU
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-cluster
          - Key: Environment
            Value: production
          - Key: Application
            Value: saas-multi-tenant
  AuroraInstanceWriter:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref AuroraCluster
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-writer
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-writer
  AuroraInstanceReader:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref AuroraCluster
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-reader
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-reader
Outputs:
  ClusterEndpoint:
    Value: !GetAtt AuroraCluster.Endpoint.Address
  ReaderEndpoint:
    Value: !GetAtt AuroraCluster.ReaderEndpoint.Address
  ClusterArn:
    Value: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:rds:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster:${AuroraCluster}
```
